threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest tube station without knowing it’s just a five-minute walk. That’s a dead giveaway.
Caught a night bus to Brixton and the driver was singing along to 90s R&B like it was a karaoke night. Most passengers grinned like it was the best gig in town.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Walking past the kids playing football in the park while the kebab shop down the street is blasting old Turkish pop—only in Neukölln, you know.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club with a swimming pool right in the dance floor. Spreepark's techno parties are a wild dive into nightlife!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to carry an extra sweater even in July—those fog banks roll in faster than a tech bro's coffee order.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo pull out a ukulele on the 19 bus, serenading a confused crowd. Only in San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss how late the locals eat dinner. While they grub at 7, we’re just starting to think about it around 9 or 10!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their confusion over the 'tapas' hours; asking for dinner at 6 PM raises some eyebrows in the bars around Plaça del Sol.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Overground' instead of knowing it's just the East London Line to most locals.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken from a late-night stall while waiting for the 35; always surprising how much life is still buzzing around at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh shawarma wafting through the streets at 2 AM after a long night, and suddenly you realize it’s home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice that the U-Bahn stations here have some of the weirdest art installations? Like, a giant rubber duck at Warschauer Straße. Totally Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by their ability to navigate the ever-changing bus routes while still rolling their eyes at BART delays. We’ve seen it all.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a Muni bus stop for a pigeon crossing the street like it was a VIP. Only in the TL do we respect the hustle of all city residents.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, missing the real gem: the small, tucked-away square where locals gather for the best vermut.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still think wearing sandals with socks is a quirky fashion statement, not a tourist flag.
